(Member nba league) is the same unstated typing — the acronym carries no kind word and the text never says league.

q2_gaps: a means/method gerund adjunct ("won X by winning Y") relating two events — the connective section covers cause, purpose, concession and contrast but not manner-of-achievement "by V-ing", and Instrument is restricted to a tool or substance
notes: By is taken as a preposition-named oblique, though the licence as written describes an entity object rather than a second event witness, which is why the construction is logged as a gap. The right-to-draft NP complement (To on the noun symbol plus a tenseless reified draft event) matches the noun-argument-PP rule, and "Thursday night" correctly composes a Weekday term with the day-part symbol.
